Writing it to a file and dispatching to zai-1 with a park.㊥ (gist) Dispatched. The packet is the brief's "within: opener" line with the missing-binder count, the item you put on the list on 10-13. It went to zai-1 at 18:50Z as a work-mode bell with a park, and the job is running. Zai's meters read 0% of the five-hour window and 1% of the month, so there is room for more.

㊢ (dispatch) Job `invoke-1792003840456-12198-00dab8d9`, park `park-09fc9c65-7ed4-40ce-afbe-13001a8e0e12`, deadline 45 minutes. The packet text is at `~/notes/packets/xiang/within-line-2026-10-14.md`. The data is there: 1,737 acts across the 943 labelled sidecars carry a within link. On wake I review the diff, run the tests, construct the bad case (an opener id absent from the records), read the live footer, and record acceptance in the mission file.

previous_reply_acts.text:
(joins made)
- **Bell ask to Agency job.** An open ask whose act id ends in a job id is asked of the Agency; ended jobs move to Recently closed with "job done" and the finish time. Live, 246 of the campaign's requisition asks closed this way. The brief's false-open count was those.
- **Fact to writing turn.** The memory version at a fact's said time names the writing session, and the latest operator record in that session becomes the line under the fact. The three M-象-2000 facts all resolve, for example the Zai window lesson "written during claude-15-turn-50, after the operator said: happy to go with your direction on this one".
- **Record to evidence row, backwards.** 62 operator records since 10-12 were written while futon1b was slow and had no evidence id. A backfill matched each to its row by session and exact text; all 62 filled, none ambiguous, log committed.
- **Record to evidence row, forwards.** Emacs now records the outbox's stable id with a delivery state of queued or acked, the server stores it, and both sides are live-reloaded.

previous_reply_acts.text: (one exchange, two turn ids) Emacs emitted the operator's evidence row before advancing the turn counter. In every typed session the user row carried turn N minus one while the assistant row and the 象 record carried N. Ten of ten acknowledged records in this session showed it. Fixed by moving the increment ahead of the hook, live in your Emacs since 18:14Z. Rows written before then keep the offset, which the backfill tolerated and the lab note records for anyone joining by turn id over history.
